# Compiler test fixtures

## `testfile.verifier`

An inner verifying key for the `verifyProof` tests, in the `verify_proof_vks`
entry format `midnight_zkir::decider::serialize_vk` writes: a decider tag byte
(`00` for `DeciderKind::None`, `01` for `DeciderKind::Collapsed`) followed by
the processed key. This one is tagged `00`.

Generated by `test-contracts/tools/verify-proof-fixtures` from the
`SingleScalarRelation` statement in `src/proofs/basic.rs`, against the midnight
SRS at `$MIDNIGHT_PP`, under the fixed RNG seed `[7; 32]`. Regenerate with:

```sh
cargo run --release --manifest-path test-contracts/tools/verify-proof-fixtures/Cargo.toml
cp test-contracts/tools/verify-proof-fixtures/out/basic.verifier compiler/testdata/
```

The seed is fixed, so a regenerated key is byte-identical unless the relation
or the proving stack changes. It is copied here rather than generated during
the test run because the compiler tests must not depend on a Rust toolchain.

Its matching proof lives beside it in `out/basic.json`; these tests need only
the key, since nothing here verifies a proof.

## `bad-tag.verifier`, `empty.verifier`

Keys `verifyProof` must reject at expansion: `bad-tag.verifier` is the single
byte `02`, which is not a decider tag, and `empty.verifier` is empty.
